# Hostname

Get or set the hostname of target hosts.

## Where it is served

| Surface | Where |
| ------- | ----- |
| API | `/api/node/{hostname}/hostname`, in [API](/category/api) |
| CLI | `osapi client node hostname` |
| Jobs | `behavior.hostname.<method>`, run by the agent |

## Built on

| Uses | Used by |
| ---- | ------- |
| Nothing | Nothing |

## Where it runs

On `linux`, `darwin`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

`update` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

`update` runs `hostnamectl` with sudo, only where it runs.

It runs `sysctl`, which the host must have installed. `osapi agent start`
warns about any that are missing.

In a trace, a call is the span `behavior.hostname.<method>`, with `exec hostnamectl`, `exec sysctl` under it.

Its span records the input `name` (update).

## Methods

| Method | Verb | Permission | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ---------- | ----------- |
| [`get`](../../usage/cli/client/node/hostname/get.md) | read | `hostname:read` | Get the hostname of the host |
| [`update`](../../usage/cli/client/node/hostname/update.md) | write | `hostname:write` | Set the hostname of the host |

## Settings

None. A behavior declares settings with `behavior.Config`.

## Inspecting it

```bash
osapi behavior get --name hostname                           # surfaces, methods, types, settings, telemetry
osapi behavior method get --name hostname --method <method>  # one method, with its JSON Schema
```
